comments.text: # Add optional `skill-index.json` for large skill catalogs and plugin packs # Add optional `skill-index.json` for large skill catalogs and plugin packs ## Summary Codex skills work well when a user has a small number of focused skills. But as users install more skills and plugins, a new problem appears: ```text routing deduplication overlap detection skill ownership multi-skill pack navigation context budget control ``` A large catalog should not require the agent to load many full `SKILL.md` files just to decide which one is relevant.
